descriptions.d10b_pulse_and_volume_80262154: Advance and wrap the pulse phase, form triangular intensity using the original single-precision arithmetic and witnessed ProDG quantized unsigned-byte cast, set RGB intensity and opaque alpha, decrement the nonzero countdown and invoke its expiration callback at zero. Read original Sfx/Ambient/Music volume properties and update mixer channels 0,3,1,2 in order with live global-service reloads. All literal bytes independently decoded from original DOL and remain unowned externals. Partial field/vtable views; full class sizes and ignored callback results unknown.
